moments.description: A blank black screen is shown while the application loads.
The "todos" application is open with an empty input field displaying the placeholder text "What needs to be done?".
The todo item "Buy milk" is added to the list, showing "1 item left" with the "All" filter active.
The todo item "Finish the hackathon demo video" is added to the list above "Buy milk", and the counter updates to "2 items left".
The todo item "Call mom" is added to the list, and the counter displays "3 items left".
The todo item "fix login bug" is added to the top of the list, and the counter displays "4 items left".
The list contains four active items: "fix login bug", "Call mom", "Finish the hackathon demo video", and "Buy milk", with "4 items left".
"fix login bug" is marked as completed with a checkmark and strikethrough, "3 items left" is displayed, and the "Clear completed" button appears.
"Finish the hackathon demo video" is marked as completed with a checkmark, leaving "2 items left".
The list displays completed items "fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" alongside active items "Call mom" and "Buy milk", showing "2 items left".
The "Active" filter is selected, showing only active items "Call mom" and "Buy milk" with "2 items left".
The "Completed" filter is selected, showing completed items "fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" along with "2 items left" and "Clear completed".
The "All" filter is selected, showing all items: completed "fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video", and active "Call mom" and "Buy milk".
The "All" filter remains highlighted with all four items shown, while the cursor hovers over the "Completed" button.
